case.description: Deterministic stuck diagnostic with robot levelled before navigation: a static, laser-invisible low wall (0.04 m tall; top at 0.04 m, well below the 0.107 m scan plane) spanning the robot's track at (0.45, 0) -- dead ahead on the first fitted leg (0, 0) -> (0.927, 0.006). move_base plans a clear path through it, but the 20 kg robot physically cannot push a static body whose top (0.04 m) sits above the base_link bottom (0.0195 m) and whose 0.28 m width overhangs the 0.238 m body. The 0.04 m wall is low enough that the robot should jam without the severe nose-up pitch observed with a 0.06 m wall, so the adaptive escape (forward probe stalls, backward succeeds) should move the robot with real displacement. Expect: no-progress STUCK after 25 s -> adaptive escape -> settle -> resume -> re-STUCK -> second recovery -> bounded termination (persistent invisible obstacle cannot be displaced).
